description: Market quotes: delayed quotes collected from Yahoo Finance (32 stock market index levels, US index futures, front-month commodity futures, US dollar exchange rates), each with its market time (asOf, UTC) and change on the previous session close; and official daily settlement prices of Chinese commodity futures (most-traded contract) read from the Shanghai and Zhengzhou exchanges, with trade date and change on the previous settlement. Every quote names its source, unit and source URL. Official daily reference rates (ECB, central banks, treasuries) are separate: use get_series_data.

group.description: indices: stock index levels; futures: US index futures; commodities: front-month commodity futures; china: official Chinese futures settlements; crypto: top 250 crypto assets in US dollars (CoinGecko); fx: US dollar exchange rates; all (default).

ids.description: Exact quote IDs, for example YF.IDX.USA (S&P 500), YF.IDX.JPN (Nikkei 225), YF.BRENT or YF.FX.EUR. Narrows the group.

name: get_market_quotes
